Lucinda Shen / Axios :

 Operand, which offers AI-powered due diligence tools for PE firms, raised $31M across a seed and a Series A led by Khosla Ventures at a $220M valuation   —  Operand, which uses AI to do due diligence for private equity firms, raised $31 million in seed and Series A funding, CEO Ram Gorthi tells Axios Pro exclusively.
